subject.title: fix(codex-native): interrupt live Codex subagent thread on tasks cancel

question: Should live Codex-native cancellation be exposed through the existing registered detached-task runtime, or is a new documented plugin/runtime seam required before this PR can proceed?
rationale: The repository policy prohibits making core depend on a plugin-specific private global, while choosing a durable replacement contract is an ownership decision that should not be inferred from this contributor patch.

options.title: Use the registered runtime seam
options.body: Route the live-thread interrupt through the existing detached-task runtime cancellation path, carrying the run ID without adding Codex-specific core logic.

options.title: Define a new documented seam
options.body: If the registered runtime cannot represent authoritative completion delivery, specify and approve a lifecycle-owned plugin/runtime interface before implementing it.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Pause the patch if no owner wants to establish the required cross-boundary cancellation contract now.

recommendation.title: Use the registered runtime seam
recommendation.body: Route the live-thread interrupt through the existing detached-task runtime cancellation path, carrying the run ID without adding Codex-specific core logic.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for the Codex-native lifecycle and extension boundary, with low confidence pending a full history trace.
